help:
ℹ️ WHAT IS POLY

One question — and two AIs (ChatGPT and Claude) work on it as a pair. It runs on your own subscriptions; the ✉ badge on a mode tells you how many messages it will spend.

EVERYDAY MODES (main menu):
⚖️ Critique — ChatGPT and Claude answer separately, without seeing each other; then Claude compares them: matched independently / did not match / what to check yourself, and gives the final answer. Your default.
🤝 Debate to agreement — for life choices with no right answer («which to choose», «should I agree»): each gives its own view first, not seeing the other's; then they see each other and argue, up to 3 rounds until one concedes; then: where they agreed, what is still disputed, what is yours to decide.
🩺 Advisor — Claude reviews YOUR text without rewriting it. The cheapest mode.
👀 Side by side — two independent opinions, no blending.
🔀 Synthesis — both answer blind, then the best is assembled. For what matters.
🧭 Auto — not sure what to pick? Poly chooses the mode for you.

In «📂 More…»:
⚔️ Decision — first steps and risks. 🗺 Dispute map — where the AIs agree and where they don't.
🥊 Debate — ChatGPT's draft and Claude's own answer, written separately → ChatGPT compares and revises → judge. For the hardest questions; expensive.
❓ Clarify — asks you follow-up questions first (the only mode where you must touch the screen mid-run — just its dialog).
➕ Additions (Delta) — a cheap stand-in for Synthesis: anchor + a list of additions. 🎨 Image — two vector sketches to choose from.
✍️ Claude writes, ChatGPT checks — Claude drafts, ChatGPT edits tone and wording (editing, not a fact-check). 📝 My own checking rule — the same, with your own one-line instruction for the checker, read from the file Poly-my-mode.txt (Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts).

The result always arrives three ways: on screen, in your clipboard (paste it anywhere) and in the journal Poly-journal.md (Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts).
While Poly is running — please wait, leave the phone as it is: a tap cancels the shortcut. Details and troubleshooting: INSTALL.md in the kit.

💻 On a laptop or PC, PolyHelper does more: folders, agents, channels, schedules, a council of several AIs. Poly on your phone is the light version, without the PC features.

Tap «Done» below, then pick «🔁 Another mode — same question» on the next screen — Poly restarts with your question and you choose a mode.
